keyFindings.finding: 57 links: 33 command mirrors + 21 hook mirrors generated by sync-runtime-mirrors.cjs, 2 hand-made whole-dir links, 1 root-file link that does not move.
19 links: 18 hook mirrors generated from .codex/hooks.json, 1 hand-made playbook link; agents/prompts are generated real files, not links.
With an .opencode compatibility link every raw target is unchanged; without it, the .opencode segment swaps to .skilled with the relative depth unchanged.
sync-runtime-mirrors.cjs hardcodes .opencode/commands (L41) and matches .opencode hook paths in configs (L110), so link regeneration must follow generator retargeting, not precede it.
